name: trident
description: Eighteen Claude skills for creators on YouTube, TikTok and Instagram, in English, Czech, Russian and Romanian: scored hooks off 26 formulas, click-surface and caption linters with current platform limits, one-video-to-three-platforms packaging, multi-part series splitting and handoff diagnosis, retention reading for long and short form, edit decision lists, clips, chapters, comments, planning, audits, an outlier finder - and a renderer that turns a script into a finished captioned short, word-by-word subtitles, series covers and weekly stats from the platforms' exports.
